DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for more than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Number of Positions
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Number of Positions
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleContinuous.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedGa.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedGa.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedLo.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRealizedLo.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealized.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealized.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position without allowance for credit loss.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealized.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealized.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

DebtSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
DebtSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.description: Amount of deferred federal income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredFinanceCostsGross.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
DeferredFinanceCostsGross.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

DeferredForeignIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
DeferredForeignIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilitiesNet.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilitiesNet.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Net Investment Gains (Losses)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) of deferred policy acquisition costs from realized net investment gain (loss).

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Other
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) to amortization expense of deferred policy acquisition cost (DAC).

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost (DAC) due to unrealized investment gain (loss).

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostForeignCurr.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment and Other
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostForeignCurr.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost due to the effect of foreign currency translation gain (loss) and increase (decrease) classified as other.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAdditions.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Capitalization
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAdditions.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Profits, Amortization (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.description: The amount of DAC and capitalized present value of future profits (also known as VOBA) that was amortized during the period, generally in proportion to related revenue earned, estimated gross profits, or over the customer relationship or some other period.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndValueOf.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndValueOf.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDispositio.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Disposition
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDispositio.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition costs disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsNet.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsNet.description: The unamortized portion as of the balance sheet date of capitalized acquisition costs that are related directly to the successful acquisition of new and renewal insurance contracts.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPeriodIncr.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPeriodIncr.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostUnrealizedI.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostUnrealizedI.description: Amount of unrealized investment gain (loss) which decreases (increases) deferred policy acquisition cost.

DeferredRevenueAndCredits.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits
DeferredRevenueAndCredits.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP.

DeferredSalesInducementCostUnrealizedGai.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investment
DeferredSalesInducementCostUnrealizedGai.description: Amount of unrealized investment gain (loss) which decreases (increases) deferred sales inducement cost.

DeferredSalesInducementsAdditions.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Capitalization
DeferredSalesInducementsAdditions.description: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized.

DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustments.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Other Increase (Decrease)
DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustments.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred sales inducement cost, classified as other.

DeferredSalesInducementsAmortizationExpe.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Amortization Expense
DeferredSalesInducementsAmortizationExpe.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred sales inducement cost.

DeferredSalesInducementsNet.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost
DeferredSalesInducementsNet.description: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBen.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBen.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredTaxAssetsCapitalLossCarryforward.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsCapitalLossCarryforward.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsGross.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
DeferredTaxAssetsGross.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsInvestments.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investments
DeferredTaxAssetsInvestments.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

DeferredTaxAssetsLiabilitiesNet.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
DeferredTaxAssetsLiabilitiesNet.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

DeferredTaxAssetsNet.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
DeferredTaxAssetsNet.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOther.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
DeferredTaxAssetsOther.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsOtherComprehensiveLoss.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Comprehensive Loss
DeferredTaxAssetsOtherComprehensiveLoss.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses in other comprehensive income.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Policyholder Liabilities
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.description: The tax effect as of the balance sheet date of the amount of the estimated future tax deductions arising from estimated policyholder reserves, which will be deductible from future taxable income when actual costs are incurred, and which can only be realized if sufficient tax-basis income is generated in future periods to enable the tax deduction to be taken.

DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

DeferredTaxLiabilities.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
DeferredTaxLiabilities.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesDeferredExpenseDef.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesDeferredExpenseDef.description: The amount as of the balance sheet date of the estimated future tax effects attributable to policy acquisition costs being expensed for tax purposes but capitalized in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, which will reverse in future periods when amortization of such capitalized costs cannot be deducted for tax purposes.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesGoodwillAndIntangi.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesGoodwillAndIntangi.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesGoodwillAndIntangi.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesGoodwillAndIntangi.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesInvestments.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investments
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesInvestments.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOther.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOther.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOtherComprehensive.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Comprehensive Income
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOtherComprehensive.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains in other comprehensive income.

DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligation.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligation.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmploye.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmploye.description: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.description: The effect of a one-percentage-point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for health care benefits.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.description: The effect of a one-percentage- point decrease in the assumed health care cost trend rates on the aggregate of the service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement health care benefit costs.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.description: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.description: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.description: The employer's best estimate, as soon as it can be reasonably determined, of contributions expected to be paid to the plan during the next fiscal year beginning after the date of the latest statement of financial position. Estimated contributions may be presented in the aggregate combining (1) contributions required by funding regulations or laws, (2) discretionary contributions, and (3) noncash contributions.

DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssets.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssets.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

DefinedBenefitPlanFundedStatusOfPlan.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
DefinedBenefitPlanFundedStatusOfPlan.description: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

DefinedBenefitPlanGrossPrescriptionDrugS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Gross Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts Received (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanGrossPrescriptionDrugS.description: Amount of the period's gross receipts received from the prescription drug subsidy, which is to be used in the roll forward of the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation of an applicable postretirement benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanHealthCareCostTrendRat.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed for Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanHealthCareCostTrendRat.description: The assumed health care cost trend rate for the next year used to measure the expected cost of benefits covered by the plan (gross eligible charges). This is based upon the annual rate of change in the cost of health care benefits currently provided by the postretirement benefit plan, due to factors other than changes in the composition of the plan population by age and dependency status.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlansWithAccumu.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionPlanWithProject.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlansWithBenefitObliga.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanPlansWithBenefitObliga.description: Amount of benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlansWithBenefitObliga.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Fair Value of Plan Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanPlansWithBenefitObliga.description: Fair value of plan assets for defined benefit plan with benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanUltimateHealthCareCost.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
DefinedBenefitPlanUltimateHealthCareCost.description: The ultimate trend rate for health care costs.

DefinedContributionPlanCostRecognized.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
DefinedContributionPlanCostRecognized.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

DepositAssets.label: Deposit Assets
DepositAssets.description: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

DepositContractsAssets.label: Deposit Contracts, Assets
DepositContractsAssets.description: Carrying amount of assets as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts paid by the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

DepositContractsLiabilities.label: Deposit Contracts, Liabilities
DepositContractsLiabilities.description: Carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts received by the insurer or reinsurer from the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

Deposits.label: Deposits
Deposits.description: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

DepositsReceivedForSecuritiesLoanedAtCar.label: Deposits Received for Securities Loaned, at Carrying Value
DepositsReceivedForSecuritiesLoanedAtCar.description: The amount of cash received as security in return for loaning securities to another party.

Depreciation.label: Depreciation
Depreciation.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet.description: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

DerivativeAssetNotSubjectToMasterNetting.label: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeAssetNotSubjectToMasterNetting.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeCollateralObligationToReturnCa.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
DerivativeCollateralObligationToReturnCa.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

DerivativeCollateralRightToReclaimCash.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
DerivativeCollateralRightToReclaimCash.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAsset.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAsset.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset offset against an obligation to return collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset offset against the right to receive collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

DerivativeInstrumentsGainLossRecognizedI.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
DerivativeInstrumentsGainLossRecognizedI.description: The amount of net gains and losses recognized in income during the period on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments in fair value hedges and related hedged items designated and qualifying in fair value hedges, on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges, and on derivative instruments not designated as hedging instruments.

DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNet.label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNet.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeNetLiabilityPositionAggregateF.label: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
DerivativeNetLiabilityPositionAggregateF.description: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

DerivativeNotionalAmount.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
DerivativeNotionalAmount.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

DirectFinancingLeaseDeferredSellingProfi.label: Direct Financing Lease, Deferred Selling Profit
DirectFinancingLeaseDeferredSellingProfi.description: Amount of deferred selling profit from direct financing lease.

DirectFinancingLeaseLeaseReceivable.label: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Receivable
DirectFinancingLeaseLeaseReceivable.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from direct financing lease.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.description: Amount of net investment in direct financing lease.

DirectFinancingLeaseUnguaranteedResidual.label: Direct Financing Lease, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
DirectFinancingLeaseUnguaranteedResidual.description: Present value expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, not guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor.

DirectPremiumsEarned.label: Direct Premiums Earned
DirectPremiumsEarned.description: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

DirectPremiumsLifeInsuranceInForce.label: Direct Premiums, Life Insurance in Force (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
DirectPremiumsLifeInsuranceInForce.description: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of life insurance in force premiums.

DirectTaxesAndLicensesCosts.label: Cost, Direct Tax and License
DirectTaxesAndLicensesCosts.description: Amount of tax incurred and cost of license directly related to good produced or service rendered.

DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalO.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalO.description: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.label: Discontinued Operation, Intra-Entity Amounts, Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Revenue
DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.description: Amount of revenue in continuing operations related to continuing involvement in a discontinued operation after disposal that before the disposal was eliminated as intra-entity transactions.

DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDisconti.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDisconti.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfIncomeLo.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfIncomeLo.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfIncomeLo.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfIncomeLo.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.description: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.description: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.description: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGai.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGai.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

DividendsCommonStockCash.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
DividendsCommonStockCash.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

DividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent.label: Dividends Payable
DividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

DividendsPreferredStock.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
DividendsPreferredStock.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

DividendsPreferredStockCash.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
DividendsPreferredStockCash.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

DueFromJointVentures.label: Due from Joint Ventures
DueFromJointVentures.description: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from an entity in which the reporting entity shares joint control with another party or group.

EarlyRepaymentOfSeniorDebt.label: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
EarlyRepaymentOfSeniorDebt.description: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

EarningsPerShareBasic.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
EarningsPerShareBasic.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

EarningsPerShareDiluted.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
EarningsPerShareDiluted.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperatio.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperatio.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFe.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFe.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

EffectOfExchangeRateOnCashAndCashEquival.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents
EffectOfExchangeRateOnCashAndCashEquival.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies.

EffectOfExchangeRateOnCashCashEquivalent.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
EffectOfExchangeRateOnCashCashEquivalent.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

EffectsOfUnrealizedHoldingGainLossOnPres.label: Effects of Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) on Present Value of Future Insurance Profits
EffectsOfUnrealizedHoldingGainLossOnPres.description: Amount of adjustment to reflect the effect that would have been recognized had the unrealized holding gain (loss) actually been realized on the present value of future insurance profits being amortized using the gross profit method and the present value of future profits recognized as a result of a purchase of an insurance entity holding long-duration contracts.

EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDer.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Asset
EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDer.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as an asset.

EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDer.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDer.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbeddedDeri.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbeddedDeri.description: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensatio.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensatio.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationCas.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationCas.description: Aggregate proceeds received by the entity during the annual period from exercises of stock or unit options and conversion of similar instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.description: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.description: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTax.description: Disclosure of the aggregate tax benefit realized from the exercise of stock options and the conversion of similar instruments during the annual period.

EntityWideDisclosureOnGeographicAreasRev.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
EntityWideDisclosureOnGeographicAreasRev.description: Revenues from external customers attributed to the entity's country of domicile.

EntityWideRevenueMajorCustomerAmount.label: Entity-Wide Revenue, Major Customer, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
EntityWideRevenueMajorCustomerAmount.description: Amount of revenue generated from a single external customer that accounts for 10 percent or more of an entity's revenues.

EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentag.label: Equity Method Investment, Ownership Percentage
EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentag.description: The percentage of ownership of common stock or equity participation in the investee accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOn.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOn.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.description: The amount of assets reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.description: The amount of liabilities reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.description: The amount of net income (loss) reported by an equity method investment of the entity.

EquityMethodInvestments.label: Equity Method Investments
EquityMethodInvestments.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOv.label: Excess of Reported Closed Block Liabilities over Assets Designated to Closed Block
ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOv.description: The difference between the liabilities of and the assets allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Five (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.description: Expected amortization expense in the fifth year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Four (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.description: Expected amortization expense in the fourth year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year One (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.description: Expected amortization expense in the first year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Three (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.description: Expected amortization expense in the third year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPrese.description: Expected amortization expense in the second year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

FairValueAssetsLevel1ToLevel2TransfersAm.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
FairValueAssetsLevel1ToLevel2TransfersAm.description: Amount of transfers of assets measured on a recurring basis out of Level 1 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 2.

FairValueAssetsLevel2ToLevel1TransfersAm.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
FairValueAssetsLevel2ToLevel1TransfersAm.description: Amount of transfers of assets measured on a recurring basis out of Level 2 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 1.

FairValueConcentrationOfRiskInvestments.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Investments
FairValueConcentrationOfRiskInvestments.description: This item represents disclosure of all significant concentrations of credit risk or market risk arising from the subject financial instrument (as defined), whether from an individual counterparty or groups of counterparties.

FairValueLevel1ToLevel2TransfersAmount.label: Fair Value, Level 1 to level 2 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FairValueLevel1ToLevel2TransfersAmount.description: The amount of the transfers of assets or liabilities measured on a recurring basis out of Level 1 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 2.

FairValueLevel2ToLevel1TransfersAmount.label: Fair Value, Level 2 to level 1 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FairValueLevel2ToLevel1TransfersAmount.description: The amount of the transfers of assets or liabilities measured on a recurring basis out of Level 2 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 1.

FairValueLiabilitiesLevel1ToLevel2Transf.label: Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
FairValueLiabilitiesLevel1ToLevel2Transf.description: Amount of transfers of liabilities measured on a recurring basis out of Level 1 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 2.

FairValueLiabilitiesLevel2ToLevel1Transf.label: Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
FairValueLiabilitiesLevel2ToLevel1Transf.description: Amount of transfers of liabilities measured on a recurring basis out of Level 2 of the fair value hierarchy into Level 1.

FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRecurringB.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
FairValueLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRecurringB.description: This element represents a certain statement of financial position liability caption which represents a class of liabilities, or which may include an individual liability, measured at fair value on a recurring basis.

FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.label: Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Can be Resold or Repledged
FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.description: Fair value of collateral permitted, by contact or custom, to be sold or re-pledged.

FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.label: Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Have Been Resold or Repledged
FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.description: Fair value of the collateral, or portion thereof, that has been re-pledged, delivered, or otherwise used.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Amount of Advances
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.description: Amount of advances from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Collateral Pledged (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.description: States the amount of the collateral pledged in support of Federal Home Loan Bank advances outstanding as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Collateral Pledged
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.description: Amount of the collateral pledged in support of federal home loan bank advances outstanding.

FederalHomeLoanBankStock.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
FederalHomeLoanBankStock.description: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAndPledgedAsCol.label: Financial Instruments Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Amount Eligible to be Repledged by Counterparty
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAndPledgedAsCol.description: Fair value of financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value and pledged to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions where counterparty has the right to re-pledge such.

FinancialServicesRevenue.label: Financial Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
FinancialServicesRevenue.description: The aggregate financial services revenue and operating interest income earned during the reporting period.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: The valuation allowance for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible that were collectively evaluated for impairment.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: The valuation allowance for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible that were individually evaluated for impairment.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: Amount of valuation allowance for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible that were individually evaluated for impairment.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.description: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

FinancingReceivableChangeInMethodCreditL.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
FinancingReceivableChangeInMethodCreditL.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable from change in methodology.

FinancingReceivableCollectivelyEvaluated.label: Financing Receivable, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
FinancingReceivableCollectivelyEvaluated.description: The balance of financing receivables that were collectively evaluated for impairment.

FinancingReceivableIndividuallyEvaluated.label: Financing Receivable, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
FinancingReceivableIndividuallyEvaluated.description: The balance of financing receivables that were individually evaluated for impairment.

FinancingReceivableModificationsNumberOf.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FinancingReceivableModificationsNumberOf.description: The number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings.

FinancingReceivableModificationsNumberOf.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts
FinancingReceivableModificationsNumberOf.description: Number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings.

FinancingReceivableModificationsPostModi.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Post-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FinancingReceivableModificationsPostModi.description: The amount of the outstanding recorded investment related to financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings after the financing receivable has been modified.

FinancingReceivableModificationsPostModi.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Postmodification
FinancingReceivableModificationsPostModi.description: Amount, after troubled debt restructuring, of modified financing receivable.

FinancingReceivableModificationsPreModif.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Pre-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FinancingReceivableModificationsPreModif.description: The amount of the outstanding recorded investment related to financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings before the financing receivable has been modified.

FinancingReceivableModificationsPreModif.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Premodification
FinancingReceivableModificationsPreModif.description: Amount, before troubled debt restructuring, of financing receivable to be modified.

FinancingReceivableModificationsRecorded.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring
FinancingReceivableModificationsRecorded.description: Amount of financing receivable modified as troubled debt restructuring.

FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.description: Number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings within the previous 12 months and for which there was a payment default.

FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts
FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.description: Number of financing receivable contracts modified as troubled debt restructuring within previous 12 months, with subsequent payment default.

FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default
FinancingReceivableModificationsSubseque.description: Amount of financing receivable modified as troubled debt restructuring within previous 12 months, with subsequent payment default.

FinancingReceivablePurchasedWithCreditDe.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
FinancingReceivablePurchasedWithCreditDe.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestment90D.label: Financing Receivable, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestment90D.description: Amount of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestmentNon.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual
FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestmentNon.description: Amount of financing receivable on nonaccrual status.

FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestmentPas.label: Financing Receivable, Past Due
FinancingReceivableRecordedInvestmentPas.description: Amount of financing receivable past due.

FinancingReceivableSignificantPurchases.label: Financing Receivable, Purchase
FinancingReceivableSignificantPurchases.description: Amount of increase from purchase of financing receivable.

FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForInve.label: Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Investment, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForInve.description: Amount of expense for allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-investment classification.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAm.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAm.description: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired.description: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Aggregate amount of intangible asset amortization recognized as expense during the period.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAverageUseful.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAverageUseful.description: The average useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForeignCurren.label: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForeignCurren.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.description: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAd.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAd.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life for foreign currency translation adjustments.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMax.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMax.description: The maximum useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMin.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMin.description: The minimum useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired1.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired1.description: Amount of increase in assets, excluding financial assets, lacking physical substance with a definite life, from an acquisition.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Realized
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.description: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized gain (loss) recognized in the income statement.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityFor.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Forward Rate Per Share
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityFor.description: The per share price of the Company's stock at which the contract holder of the freestanding contract has the right to purchase or sell the Company's stock at a future date.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySha.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySha.description: The maximum number of shares that could be issued to net share settle a contract, if applicable. If a contract does not have a fixed or determinable maximum number of shares that may be required to be issued, disclose the fact that a potentially infinite number of shares could be issued to settle the contract.

FutureAmortizationExpenseYearFive.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FutureAmortizationExpenseYearFive.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year five of the five succeeding fiscal years.

FutureAmortizationExpenseYearFour.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FutureAmortizationExpenseYearFour.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year four of the five succeeding fiscal years.

FutureAmortizationExpenseYearOne.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FutureAmortizationExpenseYearOne.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year one of the five succeeding fiscal years.

FutureAmortizationExpenseYearThree.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FutureAmortizationExpenseYearThree.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year three of the five succeeding fiscal years.

FutureAmortizationExpenseYearTwo.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
FutureAmortizationExpenseYearTwo.description: The amount of amortization expense expected to be recognized during year two of the five succeeding fiscal years.

GainLossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessNe.label: Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
GainLossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessNe.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.label: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on foreign currency fair value hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.description: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedge.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedge.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainLossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectivenessN.label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
GainLossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectivenessN.description: Amount of gain (loss)recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

GainLossOnInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
GainLossOnInvestments.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

GainLossOnSaleOfDebtInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Debt Investments
GainLossOnSaleOfDebtInvestments.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of debt securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

GainLossOnSaleOfEquityInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
GainLossOnSaleOfEquityInvestments.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of equity securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading or available-for-sale. This element includes investments in which the entity holds a small ownership stake (generally, less than 20% of the shares outstanding) and cannot exert significant influence.

GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments.description: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.description: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.description: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToS.label: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account
GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToS.description: Amount of net gains or losses recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherAssets.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherAssets.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from the sale or disposal of assets not required to be reported separately in the statement of income.

GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.label: General and Administrative Expense
GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.description: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

Goodwill.label: Goodwill
Goodwill.description: Amount after accumulated impairment loss of an asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized.

GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

GoodwillAllocationAdjustment.label: Goodwill, Allocation Adjustment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
GoodwillAllocationAdjustment.description: Purchase price allocation adjustment for allocation not yet complete at the prior year end.

GoodwillGross.label: Goodwill, Gross
